name: Bit Brother Limited
summary: Bit Brother Limited, established in 2011 and headquartered in Changsha, People's Republic of China, operates a multifaceted business. Primarily, it serves the Chinese market through the retail and distribution of specialized tea products. Its offerings include a diverse array of tea-based beverages, such as fresh milk teas, various fruit infusions, and creamy milk cap teas. Customers can also find a selection of lighter dining options, ranging from healthy salads and sandwiches to pasta, steak, and burritos, alongside an assortment of freshly baked goods like artisanal breads and various cakes, including frosted varieties. Beyond its culinary endeavors, the company has diversified into the high-tech sector, focusing on blockchain technology and digital asset mining. It also provides business management assistance and licenses its trademarks to other retail store owners. The entity rebranded as Bit Brother Limited in May 2021, having previously been known as Urban Tea, Inc.
